entries.subject: JWST observations of VEGA (programme 1193)
entries.finding: JWST observed VEGA in programme 1193 (NIRCam and MIRI imaging and coronagraphy), a image of the surrounding debris disc. The star itself is not resolved and is masked or saturated, so these give no stellar surface. Not reduced here.
entries.revisitWhen: When these observations are reduced for this body, or a resolved image or map derived from them is published.
